title: Title & Registration Services Matrix of Order Changes and Vehicle Returns
content:
Title Escalations matrix for Title & Registration Services: which changes a buyer may make to an open order before it is submitted, and what happens to the order when the vehicle comes back.

| Service type | Registration address corrected before submission without a new order | Switch between plate transfer and new plates before submission | Order cancelled when the vehicle is returned or the purchase cancelled before submission | Kestrel retitles at its own cost when the vehicle is returned after registration was issued |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

A switch between plate transfer and new plates changes the order's service type.

## Matrix readings

- Every service type allows the registration address to be corrected before submission without opening a new order.
- The plate-choice switch is open only to Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer, Kestrel In-State New Registration and Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration orders; Kestrel Title-Only Service and the two out-of-state service types do not allow it.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Kestrel In-State New Registration buyer who, before submission, wants to keep a plate already registered in the buyer's own name may switch to plate transfer; a Kestrel Out-of-State Registration buyer may not make that switch.
- Every service type cancels the order when the vehicle is returned or the purchase cancelled before submission, and every service type retitles at Kestrel's own cost when the vehicle is returned after registration was issued.
